subject: BrightCart demo request — product-search embeddings & traffic details
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightcart.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — exploring embeddings for product search

Hi Tessa,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday (trial) and I'm interested in a short demo focused on using embeddings to improve our product search relevance. We're a mid-stage e-commerce startup and need to understand throughput and cost implications for a ~500k SKU catalog.

Quick context: fast-cart browse/search drives ~1M sessions/day, peak qps around 220 rps, and we're experimenting with hybrid retrieval + rerank. Our engineering lead (cc'd) can share a small traffic snapshot.

Would love a 30-minute walkthrough this week if you have availability. What info do you need ahead of the call?

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Search & Personalization
BrightCart AI

Attachment: brightcart-traffic-snapshot.csv (CSV, 28 KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightcart.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — exploring embeddings for product search

Hi Sarah — thanks for signing up and for the context. Monica (AE) is cc'd so we can scope the right session. A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the demo and bring the right engineers: 

- Primary use case: product search relevance (hybrid retrieval + ML rerank) — any other downstream uses (recommendations, similarity, cold-start)?
- Typical request size: average query length (tokens) and expected vectors per query (top-k retrieval size)?
- Expected concurrency: you mentioned ~220 rps peak — is that sustained or burst?
- Required latency SLO for search results (p95 target)?
- Timeline: pilot start date and production target (weeks/months)?
- Any security/compliance constraints (SAML/SSO, data residency)?

If you can share answers, we can suggest one of two demo types: a product-search walkthrough (30m) or a deeper architecture session (45-60m) with an infra engineer. Also propose these slots (PDT):
- Wed Apr 28 — 10:00 or 15:00
- Thu Apr 29 — 09:30 or 16:00

If those don't work, send 2-3 times that fit your team.

Thanks — I aim to keep it concise and tactical.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123
E: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com

Hi Tessa (and Monica),

Thanks — answers inline below: 
- Use cases: primary = product search relevance; secondary = "customers also viewed" similarity lists.
- Avg query length: ~6–10 tokens. Retrieval top-k: typically 100 vectors for rerank; in production expecting to trim to top 20 for latency reasons.
- Concurrency: our normal daytime peak is ~180 rps; marketing bursts push ~220 rps for 10–20 minute intervals. Not sustained for hours.
- Latency SLO: aim for p95 < 120 ms for the whole retrieval + rerank pipeline.
- Timeline: pilot (proof-of-concept) in 4 weeks; production target in ~3 months.
- Security: SSO via Okta; data residency: US (no EU).

Attached a small traffic sample. We'd prefer Wed Apr 28 at 15:00 PDT for a 30-minute call.

Sarah
Head of Search & Personalization, BrightCart AI
